payload.purpose: Turn an authoritative spoken claim into a credible, speaker-led argument.
payload.targetViewerState: Attentive, trusting, and ready to accept the founder's earned conclusion.

grammar.hook: Open on the speaker's clearest consequential claim; never manufacture urgency.
grammar.escalation: Tighten framing only as the speaker increases specificity or stakes.
grammar.proof: Use transcript-led proof callouts and at most one source-grounded supporting insert.
grammar.reveal: Let the speaker deliver the insight before graphics restate it.
grammar.payoff: Return to a clean hero frame and preserve the decisive breath before the conclusion.
grammar.cta: Use a restrained verbal or end-card CTA only when the source supports it.

pacing.protectedPausePolicy: Preserve rhetorical pauses around claims, proof, and payoff; never cut for density alone.

caption.typographyGrammar: Sentence case with one evidence-bearing phrase emphasized; never karaoke every word.

bRoll.policy: Only source-grounded evidence that clarifies the spoken proof.

audio.musicBehavior: Warm licensed bed with no melodic competition under claims.
audio.sfxBehavior: One restrained confirmation accent on a proof or payoff beat.

brandConstraints: Honor supplied type, color, and logo safe-area rules.
accessibilityConstraints: Captions remain readable for at least 900ms.
No meaning is conveyed by color alone.

failureClasses.label: Speaker authority diluted
failureClasses.description: Graphics or inserts compete with the principal speaker.

failureClasses.label: Proof not source-grounded
failureClasses.description: A callout asserts evidence absent from the transcript or source.

failureClasses.label: Rhetorical pause destroyed
failureClasses.description: A meaningful pause is shortened or covered by an unnecessary event.

failureClasses.label: Punch-in fatigue
failureClasses.description: Reframing repeats without an editorial reason.

failureClasses.label: Performative podcast styling
failureClasses.description: Canned podcast motifs substitute for actual authority.

renderFallbacks: Use a centered speaker crop when tracking confidence is low.
Drop supporting visuals before compromising caption legibility.
provenanceRules: Every proof callout must map to transcript timestamps.
Reference Corpus media is never a render source.
